description: This Java source file defines the class `MonkeyGetAppFrameRateEvent`, which is part of the Android 'monkey' command framework. It provides functionality to execute shell commands to retrieve frame rendering data for a specified app, parse the output to determine frame counts, calculate average frame rates, and log the results to a file. It includes methods for injecting the event and processing system command output related to graphics frame rate monitoring.

classes.name: MonkeyGetAppFrameRateEvent
classes.description: A class extending `MonkeyEvent` that manages capturing and calculating the frame rate for a specific application activity by executing system dumpsys commands, parsing their output, and writing results to a log file.

methods.name: getAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Calculates the average frames per second based on total frame count and duration.

methods.name: writeAverageFrameRate
methods.description: Writes the computed average frame rate to a log file on external storage.

methods.name: getNumberOfFrames
methods.description: Parses the output of the system command to extract the number of rendered frames.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Executes the dump command, processes output to determine frame counts, updates timing info, and logs the result.
